concept0.text:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: wide panorama illustration for a wedding invitation website, used as style reference.
Primary request: a very wide panoramic painting of a Hindu wedding mandap at dusk in a garden. An ornate open four-pillared mandap with a domed canopy, draped in blush silk and strings of marigolds; a small sacred fire burning in a square brass havan kund in the centre. Marigold torans overhead. Distant soft hills and a pale palace silhouette in the far background. Banks of roses and marigolds in the foreground. Blush and peach evening sky with soft clouds.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 2:1. The top 40 percent is mostly open sky. The ground is a soft pale strip along the bottom.

concept-mehendi.text:
Use case: illustration-story
Input images: Image 1 is a style reference only. Match its medium, brushwork, paper grain and level of finish exactly. Do not copy its subject.
Primary request: a very wide panoramic painting of a mehendi garden in late afternoon. A carved wooden garden swing (jhoola) with cushions hanging on ropes wound with jasmine and marigold from the bough of a large old mango tree. Low brass trays of henna cones and rose petals on a rug beside it. Soft green lawn, distant hills, a pale haveli pavilion far away. Banks of jasmine, roses and ferns in the foreground. Soft sage, mint and warm cream sky with drifting clouds.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 2:1. The top 40 percent is mostly open sky. The ground is a soft pale strip along the bottom.

A low carved wooden seat (chowki) with a yellow silk cushion. A large brass urli bowl floating with marigold heads, brass lotas and small bowls of turmeric paste on the floor. Baskets of marigolds. Soft distant hills beyond. Warm pale gold and butter yellow sky.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 2:1. The top 40 percent is mostly open sky. The ground is a soft pale strip along the bottom.

concept-sangeet.text:
Use case: illustration-story
Input images: Image 1 is a style reference only. Match its medium, brushwork, paper grain and level of finish exactly. Do not copy its subject.
Primary request: a very wide panoramic painting of a sangeet evening in a palace garden at blue hour. An open draped pavilion stage with a low platform, a pair of dholak drums, a harmonium and floor cushions. Pierced brass lanterns of several sizes hang from above on long chains, glowing warm amber. Strings of tiny warm lights. Dusk sky of powder lilac and soft dusty indigo melting to rose at the horizon, with a few pale stars. Distant hills and palace silhouette. Night jasmine and roses in the foreground.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 2:1. The top 40 percent is mostly open sky. The ground is a soft pale strip along the bottom.
